title: Choose part of an object
summary: GraphQL: Choose part of an object. Ask for pages too.
introduction: The query picks title and leaves out pages. The resolver still holds both fields.
learningObjectives: Choose part of an object with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Choose part of an object

blocks.text: The query asks for title only. GraphQL reads that field from the resolved book and leaves pages out.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: GraphQL object fields need a selection of their inner fields.

seo.title: GraphQL: Choose part of an object
seo.description: GraphQL: Choose part of an object. Ask for pages too. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
